parts.text: 登录页的基准对比也发现了布局差异：hero背景、品牌图标、卡片标题、输入标签、按钮宽度及页脚位置。我会等注册首屏修正完成后再处理登录页，保留临时账号提示和安全交接逻辑；截图不带真实凭证。

tool_input.subject: Match login screen composition to HTML prototype
tool_input.description: After task-4 registration work, align `src/views/login.vue` to the login prototype using the already approved 2334 plan. Visual anchors: template `login.vue:36-40` temporary-account notice, `:67-100` username/password controls, notice styles around `:714-818`; compare `.task-state/2334-visual-final/current-login.png` with `.task-state/2334-visual-baseline/prototype-login.png`. Current gaps: background gradient/texture; hero vertical placement and accent rules; house brand icon; card title/subtitle; explicit “登录账号/登录密码” labels; temporary-account handoff notice presentation; full-width login action; registration/help links in one row; copyright outside the card. Add a red login UI contract first and verify it fails before production edits. Preserve the one-time Vuex credential handoff, captcha conditional enabled only by explicit backend true, validation/auth/SSO behavior, and no real credentials in screenshots, logs, files, URLs, teammate messages or browser storage. No backend edits, DB writes, dependency changes, commit or push. Run all five manual 2334 contracts/guards (including task-4 tests), changed JS/Vue script syntax checks, Vue template compilation and scoped `git diff --check`.
